description: This file defines the StateContainer class, which manages session-based state data for the installer component of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for storing and retrieving database information, application version, instance data, admin user data, registration consent, initial registration data, and migration status.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: A singleton class that provides methods to store and retrieve installer session data and application state information.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of StateContainer.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the session.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the session by key, with optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the session.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a key from the session.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all session data as an array.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection information and related credentials in the session.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns stored database information as an array.

methods.name: clearDbInfo
methods.description: Removes stored database connection information from the session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been set in the session.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Stores the database type used.

methods.name: getDbType
methods.description: Retrieves the database type used.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installer screen and whether it is an upgrader flow.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Returns the current installer screen.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Indicates if the current flow is an upgrade.

methods.name: setCurrentVersion
methods.description: Stores the current version of the application.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current application version.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization and locale data.

methods.name: getInstanceData
methods.description: Retrieves stored instance data.

methods.name: storeAdminUserData
methods.description: Stores administrator user details.

methods.name: getAdminUserData
methods.description: Retrieves admin user details.

methods.name: storeRegConsent
methods.description: Stores registration consent status.

methods.name: getRegConsent
methods.description: Retrieves registration consent status.

methods.name: storeInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Stores an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Retrieves the stored instance identifier.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration data and related flags.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data and state.

methods.name: setMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Marks migration as completed.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been completed.

methods.name: clearMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Resets migration completion status.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets the session while preserving the current screen and upgrade state.
